notes.general_comments:
154 candidates sat this paper. The mean mark was 19.8 which is slightly lower than the mean of 22.0 in
June 2014 and the mean of 20.7 in June 2013.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 2, 4, and 15. These questions
were answered correctly by 85% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of the syllabus and
were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 6, 17, and 21. These
questions were answered correctly by fewer than 45% of the candidates.
